sources.title: Huizhou University modular data-centre room procurement: October 15 amendment
sources.summary: The amended procurement includes a modular data-centre room, room refurbishment and an 800 kVA external electrical supply package. The cost schedule lists CNY 3,245,895.53 for the modular room and CNY 846,981.98 for refurbishment. Bidding is extended to November 2, 2026. These are proposed works and electrical equipment ratings, not installed IT capacity or completed construction.
sources.original_title: 惠州学院校园网升级改造及运维服务项目 更正公告
sources.author: 惠州市韶丰项目管理有限公司, the university-appointed procurement agent
sources.date_semantics: The original page visibly dates the amendment October 15, 2026. This is a fresh procurement announcement; neither an award nor a physical construction milestone is claimed.
sources.metric_scope: The 800 kVA rating is the proposed external transformer/electrical package; it is not IT MW. The full CNY 15.29 million investment requirement covers the entire campus-network and information-infrastructure project, not solely the data-centre room.

sources.title: Huizhou University campus-network and modular data-centre room upgrade tender
sources.summary: The tender proposes a modular data-centre room and supporting works as part of the university’s campus-network upgrade. It gives the service location as Huizhou University, 46 Yanda Avenue, while allowing a location designated by the purchaser. No individual room or building is identified. The contractor would fund the broader project, whose minimum investment is CNY 15.29 million; this total is not a data-centre-only budget.
sources.original_title: 惠州学院校园网升级改造及运维服务项目招标公告
sources.author: 惠州市韶丰项目管理有限公司, the university-appointed procurement agent
sources.date_semantics: September 30 is the original tender publication. Planned construction and service periods remain future contractual requirements.
sources.location_qualification: Exact original wording: 广东省惠州市惠城区演达大道46号，惠州学院内（或由招标人指定）. The selected map feature identifies the named university campus; final room placement is unspecified and purchaser designation can change the service location.
sources.status_limit: Upgrade wording implies existing campus infrastructure but does not establish the operation or location of any earlier data-centre room. No old operational status is assigned to the proposed upgrade.

sources.title: Huizhou University campus at 46 Yanda Avenue, OpenStreetMap way 677010358
sources.summary: The community-mapped university campus carries the same name and 46 Yanda Avenue address as the tender. A representative point inside this mapped campus locates the named parent property; it does not locate the proposed modular room or an individual building.
sources.date_semantics: Map edit timestamp is location context, not evidence of the 2026 work status.

sources.title: OpenStreetMap changeset 163636553: Huizhou campus geometry provenance
sources.summary: The campus map edit records local knowledge as its source and Bing Aerial as imagery used by the contributor. The Atlas uses the native community vector geometry and claims no independent imagery verification or measured positional accuracy.
sources.date_semantics: Map contribution metadata only; no construction or operations observation.
